stages.whoB: Deke's girlfriend, whom he saves and dates

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Seth and Donnie build a freezing machine at the Academy to sell to Ian Quinn, and Seth stages the attacks to bring Fitz in. Seth pushes the shy Donnie through the demonstration. When the storm runs wild, Seth helps Donnie shut it down and is killed by lightning.
stages.whoA: His partner in the freezing machine
stages.whoB: The classmate who used him, killed by their storm

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Quinn secretly pays for Seth and Donnie's freezing research, shipped through Seth's father. When S.H.I.E.L.D. gets involved, Quinn calls off the deal, and Seth begs him to stay for a demonstration that becomes a deadly storm.
stages.whoA: The tycoon buying his machine
stages.whoB: A cadet selling him a freezing machine

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Seth stages the Academy attacks so that Fitz will come and help fix the machine's power problem. When Fitz finds the device in Donnie's room, Seth knocks him out and flees to meet Quinn.
stages.whoA: The alumnus he tricks and knocks out
stages.whoB: A cadet who knocks him out

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Snowflake fights May in the jewelry vault and again at Deke's company, where Sarge takes May prisoner. May later knocks her out and brings her and Sarge in. When Sarge leaves Snowflake to die, she helps May and Daisy with his bomb.
stages.whoA: The agent she fights and admires
stages.whoB: A knife fighter of Sarge's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Snowflake first comes at Deke with her knives when Sarge's crew attacks his company. On Sarge's truck she flirts with him, and they sleep together. After she is locked up, Deke brings her a television to keep things going.
stages.whoA: Her new lover, Deke
stages.whoB: Snowflake, his killer girlfriend

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hunter looks up his old partner Spud to get a meeting with HYDRA. Spud says he must win a fight club bout, then steps into the ring himself to pay Hunter back for years of mockery. Hunter puts on knuckle dusters and kills him.
stages.whoA: His old partner, who kills him
stages.whoB: An old partner who turns on him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Stephanie shoots clay with her father and steadies him when he fears HYDRA's god will kill him, telling him to man up. The god shows her that Gideon cheated to avoid being sacrificed. Then he kills her before Gideon's eyes.
stages.whoA: Her father, Gideon
stages.whoB: His daughter, Stephanie

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: HYDRA's god, wearing Ward's body, comes to the Malick home and has Stephanie gather HYDRA's leaders, and she welcomes him as her family's god. He gives her a copy of Paradise Lost, then shows her how her father lied. Saying he still needs a Malick, he kisses her and kills her.
stages.whoA: The god she serves, who kills her
stages.whoB: Gideon's daughter, whom he kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess shows Coulson how the Lighthouse works and takes him to Virgil's room. She flies the Trawler with him, May and Mack to Virgil's coordinates. After she is brought back to life, Coulson tells her about his own return before she leaves with the refugees.
stages.whoA: The time traveler she guides
stages.whoB: A Lighthouse trader who guides him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess is an old friend of Deke and of Virgil, and is angry to hear Virgil is dead. She pays Deke double to help the people from the past. At the end she asks Flint if Deke really died to save them.
stages.whoA: An old friend on the Lighthouse
stages.whoB: An old friend on the Lighthouse

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess trades with Flint and calms him before his Terrigenesis, and the Kree kill her for it. Brought back, she tells him he can help save the world. They lead the survivors down to rebuild Earth together.
stages.whoA: Flint, the boy she protects
stages.whoB: Tess, the trader who looks out for him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess shoots Holt to save Mack and the others during the Renewal. After Kasius brings her back as his messenger, Mack and Yo-Yo send her back to him with their answer. She escapes Kasius with them and leads the refugees out.
stages.whoA: One of the agents from the past
stages.whoB: A Lighthouse trader who helps them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Kasius has Tess brought back from death and sends her to the rebels with his demands. When she returns with their answer, he chokes her in anger. She gets away from him in the blast on his level.
stages.whoA: The Kree overseer who uses her
stages.whoB: A dead trader he revives as messenger

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May takes Hannah off the downed Bus to draw Tobias away from the team, and he attacks her in a barn. May tells him he is trapped between two worlds and that he must let Hannah go. He lets go and drifts away.
stages.whoA: The agent who talks him into letting go
stages.whoB: The ghostly technician she fights

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma studies the blast and sees a window into another world, and Tobias appears and swings his wrench at her. She works out that someone else is on the plane. Later he shoves her and Fitz into a closet.
stages.whoA: The scientist he attacks on the Bus
stages.whoB: The unseen man who attacks her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon sits on Gonzales's council and wants Hunter thrown in the brig. He backs Gonzales's takeover of the Playground and pushes to bring in Skye. Gonzales sends him with Bobbi to capture her.
stages.whoA: Robert Gonzales, who leads his S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: An agent on his council

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon needles Bobbi over letting Hunter escape. They lead the team sent to bring in Skye, and he ignores her order to carry only ICERs. When he fires a live round, Skye's blast throws them both.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent who leads the hunt with him
stages.whoB: A council agent who defies her orders

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon sees Skye's powers as a danger and leads the hunt for her. When he finds her he fires a live round, and her power turns it into a blast that spears him with a tree branch.
stages.whoA: Skye, the powered agent he shoots at
stages.whoB: An agent who tries to shoot her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon and Weaver sit together on Gonzales's council. Weaver tells Jemma that Calderon brought a squadron of Quinjets to save the Academy from HYDRA. They take over the Playground side by side.
stages.whoA: A fellow council member he once saved
stages.whoB: The agent who saved her Academy

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tony and Mack were Academy roommates, the Saint and the Sinner. When S.H.I.E.L.D. corners him, he drops his guns once he sees Mack. He takes Mack to Joseph Getty and later finds Deathlok files for him.
stages.whoA: His old Academy roommate, Mack
stages.whoB: Tony Caine, his old roommate

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tony shoots at Daisy and Coulson when they find him, then helps them track down Getty. Later he hands Daisy a Centipede device, serum and Deathlok files, and helps her hide Robin and Polly.
stages.whoA: The agent he brings Centipede files
stages.whoB: Mack's old friend, a fixer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Coulson tracks Tony down through the death certificates he signed for Cybertek scientists. Tony helps the team find the Principia, and Coulson thanks him before he goes.
stages.whoA: Coulson, who thanks him for his help
stages.whoB: A fixer who helps him find gravitonium

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson questions Diaz about the Chitauri helmet and learns he is infected, not a killer. He sits with Diaz, shares what he knows about dying, and leaves only when Diaz tells him to go.
stages.whoA: The agent who sits with him at the end
stages.whoB: An infected firefighter he comforts

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi visits Toshiro in Okinawa under her HYDRA cover and gets him bragging about the Splinter Bombs. When word comes that she is S.H.I.E.L.D., he turns on her, and she shoots him with Hunter.
stages.whoA: Bobbi, an old friend who is S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: A HYDRA engineer she plays for intel

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter watches Bobbi charm Mori from the van, sulking. When Mori's guards move in, Hunter and May come in shooting, and Hunter fires with Bobbi to kill Mori.
stages.whoA: An agent who shoots him
stages.whoB: The HYDRA engineer he helps kill

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Trevor plays Deke's assistant and best friend while spying on him for S.H.I.E.L.D. When Sarge attacks, he reveals he is an agent and gets Deke out, and Deke is hurt that he called Mack. Back at the Lighthouse he keeps watch over the sedated Deke.
stages.whoA: The boss he spies on as a friend
stages.whoB: His assistant, secretly an agent

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Mack has Trevor watch Deke undercover, and Trevor calls him in when Sarge appears. Mack has him clear civilians and get Sequoia out. Later Mack and Daisy save him when Jaco breathes fire.
stages.whoA: Director Mackenzie, his boss
stages.whoB: An agent he sends undercover

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tye orders Quake to show her powers or Simmons will pay, and she slams him into a wall. Dosed with odium, he fights her and Coulson. Quake kills him with his own knife.
stages.whoA: Quake, who kills him
stages.whoB: Kasius's trainer, whom she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tye trains Inhumans to fight for Kasius's profit and reports on Abby's failures. When the Lighthouse rises up, he tells Kasius the Inhumans are not ready. Kasius forces odium on him and sends him after the agents.
stages.whoA: Kasius, who owns his fighters
stages.whoB: His trainer of Inhuman fighters

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Raging on odium, Tye attacks Coulson and Daisy and shrugs off their ICER shots. He cuts Coulson with his knife before Daisy kills him.
stages.whoA: An agent he cuts in a fight
stages.whoB: Kasius's odium-crazed trainer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: After the Quinjet crash, Mace bluffs Orlov with a case only he can open and offers to talk it through. Orlov says his men could just kill him and take it, and they open fire.
stages.whoA: The Director he hunts after the crash
stages.whoB: The merc leader who hunts him after the crash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack wrecks the jamming truck Orlov's men guard, and Orlov comes after him in close combat. Mack holds on until May arrives, and together they beat Orlov.
stages.whoA: The agent who wrecks his truck and beats him
stages.whoB: The merc leader he beats with May

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: May flies in to rescue Mace's party and finds Orlov fighting Mack. Together they take him down, though he wounds her in the fight.
stages.whoA: The agent who takes him down with Mack
stages.whoB: A merc leader who wounds her in a fight

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil finds Coulson just after the monolith sends him away and tells him he is one of the True Believers, who believe in him. Before he can explain more, Mack knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. hero he always believed in
stages.whoB: A True Believer who greets him on arrival

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Mack sees Virgil standing over Coulson with a strange gun and punches him out. When Virgil wakes, he greets Mack by his full name as a hero he has studied for years.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocked him out
stages.whoB: A stranger he punched, who knew his name

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil names Simmons and her field and tells her Fitz is thinking of her. He is explaining why the team was brought there when a Vrellnexian kills him.
stages.whoA: An agent he knew from his studies
stages.whoB: A stranger who knew her and Fitz

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil greets Yo-Yo by name and asks if he can call her Yo-Yo, and she says no. Moments later a Vrellnexian kills him in front of the team.
stages.whoA: An agent he knew from his studies
stages.whoB: A stranger who knew her name

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Fitz poses as a Sivian engineer on Viro's ship until Viro exposes him as a Terran. Fitz bargains to work for free, then stands against Viro's plan to space the crew and tricks him into opening the wrong airlock.
stages.whoA: The Terran engineer who tricked him
stages.whoB: The captain who made him work for free

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Viro finds Enoch hiding aboard with Fitz and spares them both as unpaid labor. Enoch warns Fitz that going against Viro means joining the crew in the airlock, then sees Viro die by his own hand.
stages.whoA: Fitz's stowaway, kept as free labor
stages.whoB: The captain who held him and Fitz

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Cal calls Levi an old buddy, frees him of his S.H.I.E.L.D. chip, and has him decrypt the Index to find the rest of the team. Levi hacks Brynmore and a high school for Cal's showdown with Coulson.
stages.whoA: His old friend and team leader
stages.whoB: An old buddy who hacks for his team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson reads out Levi's file, a genius with no moral compass. At the high school, Levi begs Coulson not to hit him, and Coulson knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A genius hacker on Cal's team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy catches Zaikin after he shoots at Mace. She reads out his record in the interrogation room, but he will not name his supplier.
stages.whoA: The agent who caught him
stages.whoB: An ex-Hydra sniper she caught

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Talbot tries to break Zaikin, who calls him glass to Hydra's hammer. Talbot brings in Simmons, and Zaikin admits the Watchdogs hired him.
stages.whoA: The general who interrogates him
stages.whoB: An ex-Hydra assassin he breaks

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Zaikin mocks Talbot for bringing a woman to scare him. Simmons shows him what happened to the last Hydra operative they caught, and he gives up the Watchdogs.
stages.whoA: The scientist who scares him into talking
stages.whoB: A captured assassin she scares into talking

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Zaikin fires exploding bullets at Director Mace at a public event but misses. Once he talks, S.H.I.E.L.D. learns the plan was to bring down Mace's Quinjet.
stages.whoA: The Director he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The sniper who tried to kill him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Fitz walks into Hadad's den to trade a locked case for a scroll casing tied to the monolith. Hadad hands it over for splinter bombs, but the bomb he throws is a flash grenade and Fitz escapes.
stages.whoA: The Scot who tricked him in a trade
stages.whoB: A broker of looted relics

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev is Grill's right-hand man at the salvage and keeps the new workers in line. Grill sends him on the Trawler run to find proof of stealing, then believes he hid a gun and has him punished as a violator.
stages.whoA: His boss at the salvage
stages.whoB: His right-hand man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev shocks Mack at the salvage and gives him a hard time on the Trawler. When Zev pins the agents with their Metrics, Mack knocks him out and locks him up.
stages.whoA: A new worker he bullies
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer, who bullies him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev shocks Yo-Yo for working too slowly and calls her new girl. After his sabotage, she plants a gun on him with her speed, and Grill has him killed.
stages.whoA: The new girl who frames him
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer, whom she frames

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev walks Coulson's group through Grill's salvage as new workers and rides along on their Trawler run. When they find Virgil's hidden radio, he pins them to the walls with their Metrics.
stages.whoA: A new worker on the Trawler run
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer at the salvage

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ava tells how her father Elihas Starr kept up his quantum work after Hank Pym had him fired. When his tunnel overloads he tells her to run, but she stays, and the blast kills her parents and leaves her phasing in pain.
stages.whoA: His daughter, Ava
stages.whoB: Her father, a fired S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Elihas Starr and Hank Pym are colleagues in quantum research at S.H.I.E.L.D. until Hank has him fired and discredited. Ava blames Hank for her father's fate, while Hank calls Starr a traitor who stole his plans.
stages.whoA: The colleague who had him fired
stages.whoB: A fired S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum brings Scott and Cassie to Jentorra and presses her to torture them. When Kang's forces strike, she orders him to get her people away. Later he hands her back her staff and fights beside her in the revolt.
stages.whoA: The leader of his rebels
stages.whoB: One of her rebels

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Quaz hold Scott and Cassie in the rebel camp. Quaz reads their minds and tells Xolum to stop suggesting they torture people.
stages.whoA: A telepath among the rebels
stages.whoB: A rebel who keeps urging torture

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Veb are among the rebels who greet Scott and Cassie after they drink the ooze. Both are taken prisoner in the raid on the camp and join the revolt against Kang.
stages.whoA: A fellow rebel
stages.whoB: A fellow rebel

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum saves Scott and Cassie from a monster, then wants Scott tortured as a spy. In the end he fights on the same side against Kang.
stages.whoA: A stranger he rescues and wants to torture
stages.whoB: A rebel who rescues him, then wants him tortured

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum rescues Cassie and her father and urges the rebels to torture them. After Kang captures the rebels, Cassie frees them and calls the Quantum Realm to revolt, and Xolum fights in the uprising she starts.
stages.whoA: The girl who sparks the revolt
stages.whoB: A rebel who fights in her revolt

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Kang's forces raid the rebel camp and take Xolum prisoner. When the rebels rise up, Kang suits up and kills Xolum with a single blast to the head.
stages.whoA: The conqueror who kills him
stages.whoB: A rebel he kills

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Smitty oversees the dive that sends Salazar and Jackson to the vibranium detector on the seabed. Salazar reports that Jackson is gone and her signal dies as the ship comes under attack.
stages.whoA: A diver on his operation
stages.whoB: The officer running her dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: As a strange song lures the crew overboard, Smitty fights back with earplugs and a gun. Attuma drags a sailor into the sea and throws a spear that kills Smitty.
stages.whoA: The undersea warrior who kills him
stages.whoB: An American officer he kills

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Under Dreykov's control, Yelena hunts Oksana in Morocco for the antidote gas and stabs her. Dying, Oksana sprays Yelena with the gas, freeing her, and tells her to free the others.
stages.whoA: The Widow who kills her and is freed by her
stages.whoB: The older Widow she kills, who frees her

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Yelena leads a team of Widows in Morocco to take the antidote gas from Oksana, who sets off smoke and flees on foot. After Oksana dies, the team reports Yelena as a deserter.
stages.whoA: The Widows sent to take her antidote gas
stages.whoB: The older Widow whose antidote gas they hunt

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Agent Taylor guards President Ross at the White House summit, on his flight to Tokyo, where he orders her to get him to the Indian Ocean within the hour, and at Celestial Island. When Ross turns into a red Hulk at the Rose Garden, she opens fire on him.
stages.whoA: The President she guards
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, who guards him

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Taylor brings Sam to Ross at the White House summit and tells him to keep an open mind. When the red Hulk buries Sam in rubble, she helps Ruth pull him out.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom she brings to Ross
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, Ross's guard

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Taylor and Ruth both serve President Ross. When the red Hulk knocks Sam into the rubble at the White House, the two of them pull him free together.
stages.whoA: Ross's adviser, who helps her rescue Sam
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, Ross's guard

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ross, who says he and Ozaki go back a long way, greets him at the White House summit, but Japan pulls out of the treaty after the attack there. In Tokyo, Ozaki accuses Ross of stealing Japan's adamantium, and over Celestial Island he refuses to believe the American pilots went rogue.
stages.whoA: The US President he blames for the theft
stages.whoB: Japan's prime minister, Ozaki

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ross introduces Sam to Ozaki at the White House summit, and the two pose for a photo together. Later, Sam stops the rogue American pilots firing on Japan's fleet.
stages.whoA: Captain America, met at the summit
stages.whoB: Japan's prime minister, met at the summit

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Hodge and Steve are both recruits at Camp Lehigh, and Hodge is Phillips' favorite. When Phillips throws a dummy grenade, Hodge dives for cover while Steve throws himself on it.
stages.whoA: The skinny recruit picked over him
stages.whoB: The bully Phillips wanted to pick

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Hodge mocks Agent Carter's accent and makes a crude pass at her in front of the recruits. She has him step forward and knocks him to the ground.
stages.whoA: The officer who knocks him down
stages.whoB: The recruit she knocks down

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Phillips backs Hodge as his choice, saying he passed every test, is big and fast and obeys orders. Phillips' dummy grenade test ends up proving Steve the better man instead.
stages.whoA: The colonel who wants him chosen
stages.whoB: The recruit he wants chosen

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Kevin secretly cancels Karen's deferment so she has to leave Fagan Corners for college. When she plans to run off with Todd, Kevin burns Todd's trailer, and he dies when Karen crashes the car as they flee.
stages.whoA: His older sister, who blames herself for his death
stages.whoB: Her younger brother, killed in the crash she caused

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Kevin works the family diner with his father and backs him when Paxton fights with Karen over Todd. After Kevin dies in the crash, Paxton sends Karen away.
stages.whoA: His father, who runs the diner
stages.whoB: His son, who dies in Karen's crash

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Louisa works the Metro-General ER beside Claire through a night of gang casualties. When Hand ninjas storm the ward where Claire is hiding the children, Louisa jumps in front of Claire and is killed, and the hospital's cover-up drives Claire to quit.
stages.whoA: A fellow nurse she dies protecting
stages.whoB: A fellow nurse who dies saving her

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Louisa brushes Foggy off in the overflowing ER when he comes looking for Claire. She later stops him, Matt and Karen from reaching Castle until they explain they are his lawyers.
stages.whoA: A lawyer she keeps out of her way
stages.whoB: A busy nurse who keeps him at bay

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell works for Ellison at the Bulletin and hands him the list of blast sites, while secretly passing what she hears to Fisk. Ellison watches in shock as the FBI arrests her at her desk.
stages.whoA: Her editor at the Bulletin, whom she spies on
stages.whoB: A secretary who turns out to be Fisk's mole

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell is Urich's colleague at the Bulletin, and he even hands her his fundraiser piece. When Ellison fires him, she tips off Fisk that Urich may publish online, and Fisk kills him that night.
stages.whoA: A reporter she betrays to Fisk
stages.whoB: A colleague secretly spying for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell is Fisk's mole inside the Bulletin. She tells him about Urich's firing, and she is arrested with the rest of his network.
stages.whoA: The man she secretly informs for
stages.whoB: His mole inside the Bulletin

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Marlene shields young Wilson from his violent father, and when Wilson kills Bill to stop him beating her, she helps him get rid of the body. Years later he hides her in a care home, then moves her out of the city when Karen and Urich find her.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she protected
stages.whoB: His mother, whom he protects at all costs

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Marlene worries over Bill's loan from Rigoletto and his failed campaign. One night he beats her with his belt, and their son Wilson kills him with a hammer.
stages.whoA: Her abusive husband
stages.whoB: His wife, whom he beats

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Karen visits Marlene at Saint Benezet with Urich and draws her out about her marriages and her son. Marlene lets slip that Wilson killed his father, insisting it was not his fault.
stages.whoA: A kind visitor who asks about her son
stages.whoB: Fisk's mother, who reveals his secret

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Urich comes to Saint Benezet with Karen to find Fisk's mother. When he asks if her son is Wilson Fisk, Marlene recalls the night Wilson killed his father.
stages.whoA: A visitor who asks about Wilson
stages.whoB: Fisk's mother, the source for his story

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Michael thanks Matt for getting sixteen years off his sentence and agrees to keep their talk secret. But when Matt pushes for an introduction to Vic Jusufi, Michael panics and punches him so the Albanians see he gave nothing away.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who cut his sentence
stages.whoB: An old client inside Rikers

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mockta corners Daredevil in the hotel garage and holds him at gunpoint, blaming him for the agents killed in the ambush, until Daredevil knocks him out. At the wedding, Mockta fires on Daredevil and Dex.
stages.whoA: The masked man he takes for an assassin
stages.whoB: An agent who holds him at gunpoint

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley puts Mockta on Fisk's detail, sends him with Nadeem to the Bulletin, and posts him at the wedding. Nadeem names them both among Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: One of her agents on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mockta rides with Nadeem to the Bulletin to bring in Matt and is knocked down by the fake Daredevil on the way in. Nadeem later names him among the agents working for Fisk.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads the Bulletin raid
stages.whoB: An agent on his Bulletin raid

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex, in Daredevil's suit, knocks Mockta down during the Bulletin raid. At the wedding Dex turns on Fisk and kills Mockta with thrown cutlery, then takes his gun.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills him at the wedding
stages.whoB: An agent he kills at the wedding

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil fights off the men trying to kidnap Neda and her father. He later visits her at the hospital, says the attackers are in police custody, and tells her it was him, not God, who saved them.
stages.whoA: The masked man who saves her and her father
stages.whoB: A woman he saves from kidnappers

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Karen finds Neda at her father's bedside and wins her trust by sharing what happened when her brother died. Neda tells her a man in a black mask saved them, which sends Karen after the Kazemis' hotel deal.
stages.whoA: A reporter she finally talks to
stages.whoB: A source who saw the masked man

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nesbitt gathers the Kitchen Irish at their club to plan their return to power. Before he can finish his toast, the Punisher shoots him through the window and wipes out the room.
stages.whoA: The gunman who kills him
stages.whoB: An Irish boss he kills mid-speech

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Grotto fetches Nesbitt a drink as the Kitchen Irish gather to hear his speech. Grotto is the only one to survive when the Punisher opens fire.
stages.whoA: A Kitchen Irish underling
stages.whoB: His boss in the Kitchen Irish

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor meets Nadeem at the hotel after the ambush and is put on Fisk's detail with him, then rides with him to the Bulletin. When Hattley brings Nadeem in to meet the agents Fisk has turned, O'Connor is among them.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads Fisk's detail
stages.whoB: An agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley assigns O'Connor to Fisk's detail, sends him to the Bulletin, and posts him on the wedding cameras. Nadeem names them both as Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: One of her corrupt agents

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor watches the wedding through the hotel's security cameras for Fisk. Daredevil bursts into the room and beats him.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who beats him at the wedding
stages.whoB: A corrupt agent he takes down

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor guards Fisk at the Presidential Hotel and becomes one of his corrupt agents, guarding his wedding. He is arrested along with the rest of Fisk's people.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards, then serves
stages.whoB: One of his agents inside the FBI

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Paxton fights with Karen over the failing diner and Todd, and after Kevin dies in the crash he tells her he does not want her there. Years later he picks up her call after the Bulletin attack but says it is not a good time for her to come home.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he sends away
stages.whoB: Her father, who turns her away

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Daredevil and Elektra ambush Philip in his apartment, and Daredevil holds him against the cracking window until he agrees to decode the ledger. Daredevil warns him to find better business partners.
stages.whoA: The masked man who forces him to talk
stages.whoB: The cryptographer who decodes the ledger

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra tracks down Philip as the man who encoded the Yakuza ledger. She threatens him until he decodes it, then knocks him out.
stages.whoA: A masked woman who threatens him
stages.whoB: The professor she tracks down

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: The masked man takes down Piotr's crew and demands to know where Vladimir is. Piotr begs for his life, and the police arrive and arrest him.
stages.whoA: The masked man who corners him
stages.whoB: A Russian he interrogates

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Blake mocks Piotr in the interrogation room until Piotr offers the name Wilson Fisk for a deal. Blake uncuffs him, stages a struggle with Hoffman, and shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The detective who kills him
stages.whoB: A Russian he kills for naming Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Hoffman questions Piotr with Blake, then lets Blake punch him so they can claim Piotr attacked them. Blake shoots Piotr in the staged struggle.
stages.whoA: A detective in on his murder
stages.whoB: A Russian killed in their staged struggle

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Prohaszka refuses to let Healy join his private game and has his guards throw him out. Healy beats the guards, fights Prohaszka, and kills him with a bowling ball.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him at the bowling alley
stages.whoB: The mobster he kills

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey and Arinori flatter Hattley to win Fisk's case, and she puts Ramsey on Fisk's guard instead. He becomes one of her agents working for Fisk until they are all exposed.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: An agent who courts her favor

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey congratulates Nadeem on the Albanian raid while trying to take Fisk's case from him. He is among the corrupt agents Hattley shows to Nadeem, and Nadeem later names him as one of Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: A rival agent for Fisk's case
stages.whoB: An agent competing for Fisk's case

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey and Dex pick up Fisk from the hotel together as Fisk's agents. When Dex attacks the wedding, he knocks Ramsey out.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent working for Fisk
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's side

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper denies Matt's bail request for Hector Ayala but sides with him in chambers, keeping White Tiger out of the trial. When Matt reveals Ayala is White Tiger anyway, Cooper calls him slippery for misleading the court but lets the trial go on.
stages.whoA: Defense lawyer in the Ayala trial
stages.whoB: Judge in Hector Ayala's trial

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper remands Hector without bail on the charge of killing a police officer. After the jury finds him not guilty on every count, Cooper tells him he is free to go.
stages.whoA: Defendant he jails, then frees
stages.whoB: Judge who denies bail, then frees him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Held hostage together at New York Mutual Bank, Johnny tells Matt the vault holds only safety deposit boxes. When the police clear the bank, Johnny vouches that Matt was a hostage.
stages.whoA: Fellow hostage at the bank
stages.whoB: Fellow hostage who vouches for him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Johnny tells Mayor Fisk he voted for him and has worked in Sanitation for 35 years. He then reveals that Muse's mural is made of human blood, and Fisk sends for Gallo.
stages.whoA: The mayor he reports to
stages.whoB: Sanitation worker who finds the blood

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Sheila brings Johnny to Fisk's office with urgent news about the mural. When he rambles, she pushes him to tell the Mayor what he told her.
stages.whoA: Aide who brings him to the Mayor
stages.whoB: Sanitation worker with urgent news

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez and the Attorney General confront Fisk over his emergency powers and the Safer Streets Initiative. He later stands beside Governor McCaffrey as she warns Fisk she can revoke Red Hook's free port status.
stages.whoA: Mayor he challenges for the state
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor who challenges him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez tells Governor McCaffrey the Red Hook charter came from an anonymous source, and she tells him nothing is anonymous. Later he tells Buck Cashman she promised to back his run for her office.
stages.whoA: The Governor he serves
stages.whoB: Her Lieutenant Governor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez demands to know what the CIA is doing in Fisk's office. Mr. Charles mocks his job title and calls him Juan.
stages.whoA: CIA man who mocks him
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he mocks

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At the Gracie Mansion dinner, Daniel pumps a drunk Gomez for talk about the Governor. Gomez insists she is squeaky clean, but Daniel says everybody has something.
stages.whoA: Fisk aide fishing for dirt
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he pumps for dirt

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At Vanessa's wake, Gomez tells Buck that McCaffrey promised to support his candidacy. Buck asks why he should wait and hints he may not need to campaign at all.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who tempts him
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he sounds out

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell rough up their informant Nicky Torres in a subway station, and Shanahan dies in the fight with Hector Ayala. On the stand, Powell calls Kel his partner of eight years and his best friend.
stages.whoA: His partner and best friend
stages.whoB: His late partner and best friend

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector steps in as Shanahan and Powell beat Nicky Torres. Shanahan charges him, misses, trips and falls in front of a train, and Hector is charged with his murder.
stages.whoA: The man he charges on the platform
stages.whoB: Cop whose death he is tried for

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell accuse their informant Nicky of dodging them and start beating him on a subway platform. Shanahan grabs him, then lets go to help Powell, and Nicky runs.
stages.whoA: Informant he beats
stages.whoB: Cop who beats him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt takes Leroy's caramel corn theft case, and Leroy insists on probation while mocking his blindness. Matt wins him ten days and loses his temper, then listens as Leroy explains how the system keeps grinding him down.
stages.whoA: His lawyer
stages.whoB: Client in a caramel corn theft

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Lionel, who bullied Foggy as a boy, turns up as his client and refuses a plea deal. Foggy finds the flaw in the warrant that frees him, then gives him the firm's savings to start over, and Lionel says he never had a friend like that.
stages.whoA: Childhood neighbor who gives him a fresh start
stages.whoB: Childhood bully he saves

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt and Foggy are assigned to get Lionel to plead out, but he mocks Matt's blindness and refuses. Matt doubts he deserves to walk, yet helps get the charges thrown out over the bad warrant.
stages.whoA: One of his lawyers
stages.whoB: Client freed on a bad warrant

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa runs the Five Families table and rules that Red Hook is exempt from Luca's toll. Luca later urges her to take back control and get rid of Wilson, and her text sends him into Buck Cashman's ambush.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table
stages.whoB: Five Families boss she sets up

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca barges into the Mayor's office and refuses to pay Viktor, so Fisk raises his debt to $2.8 million. Luca later sneaks up on Fisk at a restaurant with a gun, and Buck shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The Mayor he tries to kill
stages.whoB: Mob boss who defies him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca demands a toll from Viktor's trucks, and Viktor reminds him Red Hook is exempt. After a deadly hijacking, Luca is ordered to pay Viktor $1.8 million and refuses.
stages.whoA: Rival Five Families boss
stages.whoB: Rival Five Families boss

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck tells Luca he owes Viktor $1.8 million, and Luca calls him the mayor's errand boy. When Luca moves on Fisk at a restaurant, Buck is waiting and kills him.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who kills him
stages.whoB: Mob boss he kills

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa scolds Viktor for being rude at the Five Families table but backs him on the Red Hook toll. The meeting ends when Wilson Fisk walks in.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table
stages.whoB: Five Families boss she backs

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck settles the hijacking feud for the Fisks and rules that Luca owes Viktor $1.8 million. Viktor is satisfied with the terms.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who rules in his favor
stages.whoB: Five Families boss owed restitution

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt finds Nicky first and sends him out the fire escape before the cops arrive to silence him. On the stand, Nicky lies that he was home all night, and Matt withdraws him as a witness.
stages.whoA: Lawyer who saves him
stages.whoB: Key witness who lies

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Powell and Shanahan accuse Nicky of dodging them and beat him in a subway station. Powell later tracks him to his apartment to stop him from testifying.
stages.whoA: Cop who beats him
stages.whoB: Informant he beats

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector breaks up the beating Nicky is taking from two cops, and Nicky runs. Called to back Hector's story at trial, Nicky lies and says he was never there.
stages.whoA: The man who saved him
stages.whoB: Man he saved, who lies in court

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Jack is the son of Phastos and Ben, and Phastos checks his teeth and tucks him in when Ikaris and Sersi come calling. Phastos leaves to rejoin the Eternals, and afterward father and son watch the Domo leave Earth together.
stages.whoA: His father, secretly an Eternal
stages.whoB: His young son

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ben and Phastos are raising Jack together. Ben tells Phastos to go with the Eternals if it means they can watch Jack grow up.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His son with Phastos

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: When a toaster gives Thena trouble, Jack tells her life is complicated for him too. She conjures a spear to fetch him an orange, and Phastos scolds her for showing his son violence.
stages.whoA: His father's friend, an Eternal
stages.whoB: Phastos's son

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: High Councilor Rakim scolds Basha for taking the whole statue head and warns him not to treat missions like a contest. When the gallery is found wrecked, Basha calls it a training drill, and Rakim leaves him to clean it up.
stages.whoA: An agent under his command
stages.whoB: His High Councilor

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Rakim sends Ebo away so he can speak with Basha alone. Told that the wrecked gallery was Ebo's training drill, Rakim congratulates him and promotes him to field operative.
stages.whoA: An officer he promotes
stages.whoB: His High Councilor

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter brings the Orb to the Broker's shop on Xandar to sell it. The moment Peter mentions Ronan, the Broker refuses the deal and throws him out.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who tries to sell him the Orb
stages.whoB: A Xandar dealer who refuses the Orb

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Yondu meant to sell the Orb through the Broker. After Peter runs off with it, Yondu threatens the Broker in his shop until he names the Collector as his buyer.
stages.whoA: A Ravager captain who threatens him
stages.whoB: A dealer he forces to talk

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin comes with Yondu to lean on the Broker, who gives up the Collector as his buyer.
stages.whoA: One of Yondu's Ravagers
stages.whoB: A dealer Yondu threatens

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Now neighbors on Knowhere, the Broker plays cards with Kraglin. When Cosmo keeps moaning about being called a bad dog, the Broker begs Kraglin to take it back, and Kraglin refuses.
stages.whoA: A card partner on Knowhere
stages.whoB: A card partner on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax, out for revenge, holds a knife to the dispatcher's throat on Knowhere. He forces him to send Ronan a message calling him there to fight.
stages.whoA: A man who threatens him at knifepoint
stages.whoB: A dispatcher he forces to call Ronan

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: The dispatcher spends Christmas on Knowhere with Kraglin and their neighbors. He is disgusted when Cosmo gives Kraglin a dead Orloni as a present.
stages.whoA: A friend on Knowhere
stages.whoB: A friend on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Steemie jeers at Kraglin's clumsy practice with the arrow and laughs when Cosmo shows him up. In the battle, Kraglin tells Steemie he's up, and Steemie fires Knowhere's cannon at the lab.
stages.whoA: A friend who flies Knowhere
stages.whoB: Steemie, a friend on Knowhere

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Bzermikitokolok's band plays Peter a song they wrote about Christmas. Peter points out that much of what it says about Christmas is wrong.
stages.whoA: The Guardian who owns Knowhere
stages.whoB: A Knowhere bandleader

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Kevin Bacon joins Bzermikitokolok's band on stage for a Christmas song while the Guardians swap presents. Afterward, the band watches him head home to Earth.
stages.whoA: A guest singer from Earth
stages.whoB: The bandleader he sings with

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Bzermikitokolok plays cards with Kraglin and the others on Knowhere. When the High Evolutionary's creatures invade, Kraglin fights them off with the arrow to protect him and the other residents.
stages.whoA: A card partner who defends Knowhere
stages.whoB: A card partner on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Caught stealing from OrgoCorp, Fitz-Gibbonok refuses to tell Ayesha where Gamora is. After he dies, Ayesha takes his communicator and tricks Gamora into sending her location.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign priestess who questions him
stages.whoB: A Ravager she questions

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Ayesha tells Adam to show the captured Fitz-Gibbonok they mean business. Adam disintegrates him instead, leaving them nothing to learn from him.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager he kills

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Fitz-Gibbonok rides with the Ravagers who meet the Guardians, and he dies refusing to give Gamora away. Gamora later calls him on his communicator, not knowing Ayesha now holds it.
stages.whoA: A fellow Ravager
stages.whoB: A fellow Ravager

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter flirts with Ura at her desk under the name Patrick Swayze, then has her pull Rocket's file once Gamora draws a gun. At the security hub she sets up the monitor for him, and he uses it to hack the Orgosentries and escape.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who flirts with her as Patrick Swayze
stages.whoB: An OrgoCorp manager who helps him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Gamora barges in on Ura and holds her at gunpoint to get Rocket's file. When the Orgosentries close in, Gamora takes her hostage to get the Guardians out.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: An OrgoCorp manager she takes hostage

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Vim serves the High Evolutionary as one of his Recorders and takes his scorn when Rocket slips away. As his lab breaks apart, she defies him and tries to take command of the ship, and he kills her.
stages.whoA: Her master
stages.whoB: One of his Recorders

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: War Pig reports to Vim that she has 89P13 and is on her way back. Vim then tells the High Evolutionary that they have the subject.
stages.whoA: The guard sent to fetch Rocket
stages.whoB: The Recorder she reports to

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: War Pig guards the High Evolutionary's lab and scans the Guardians who come to see him. On his order she flies to the Bowie to bring him Rocket.
stages.whoA: Her master
stages.whoB: A guard who serves him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Gamora finds War Pig carrying Rocket off the Bowie and orders her to drop him at gunpoint. War Pig slams her into a wall and flies on.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who tries to stop her
stages.whoB: A guard who takes Rocket

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Adam crashes into War Pig on the Bowie to take Rocket for himself. She protests that they work for the same boss, but he says he needs the credit and tears off her head.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign who kills her
stages.whoB: A rival guard he kills

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev livestreams Shaun's fight against the men who attack him on a San Francisco bus. He cheers Shaun on and grades the fight for his viewers as it goes.
stages.whoA: The bus passenger whose fight he livestreams
stages.whoB: The vlogger who livestreams his bus fight

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev and Katy are on the bus when Shaun is attacked. With the driver knocked out, Klev refuses to drive, and Katy takes the wheel.
stages.whoA: The passenger who drives the bus he will not
stages.whoB: The vlogger who refuses to drive the bus

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev cheers for Shaun until a man with a blade for an arm joins the attack on the bus, then takes it back. The attacker slices the bus apart as Klev keeps filming.
stages.whoA: The bladed attacker who wrecks his bus
stages.whoB: A vlogger filming on the bus he wrecks

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo and Katy are old friends who once went joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Over dinner Soo urges Katy to use her Berkeley degree, then watches Wong lead Katy away through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, a valet with a Berkeley degree
stages.whoB: Her old friend, now a lawyer

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo tells Shaun he is wasting his talents parking cars. Two weeks later she mocks his story of saving the world, until Wong calls for Shang-Chi and takes him through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend Shaun, who speaks four languages
stages.whoB: An old friend who says he is wasting his talents

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched blurts out Jen's firing at a family dinner and later barges into her apartment with She-Hulk goods to sign. When Jen says Titania owns the name, he lectures her on trademarks. He also DJs Lulu's wedding and joins the family barbecue.
stages.whoA: His cousin Jen, a lawyer who is also She-Hulk
stages.whoB: Her cousin, a Best Buy manager

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched excitedly greets Bruce when he turns up at the family barbecue, back from Sakaar. When Bruce introduces his son Skaar, Ched asks about the space thing.
stages.whoA: His cousin Bruce, back from Sakaar
stages.whoB: A cousin at the family barbecue

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to bring up Jen's firing, but Ched blurts it out, saying he thought Morris wanted it mentioned. Both are at the family barbecue too.
stages.whoA: Jen's dad, who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca yells at Ched when he blurts out Jen's firing at the family dinner. Both later sit down to the family barbecue with Matt Murdock.
stages.whoA: A relative who scolds him at dinner
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched DJs Lulu's wedding as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk, hyping her guests at the reception.
stages.whoA: The bride whose wedding he DJs
stages.whoB: The DJ at her wedding

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck calls Jen on a Sunday after Blonsky's inhibitor sends a malfunction alert and asks her to meet him at the retreat as backup. He urges her to hulk out, then leaves once the device is fixed.
stages.whoA: Blonsky's lawyer, his backup at the retreat
stages.whoB: Blonsky's parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck checks on Blonsky at his retreat after an inhibitor alert, fearing he will find the Abomination. Blonsky blames a jolt from an electric fence, and Chuck recalibrates the inhibitor.
stages.whoA: The parolee he supervises
stages.whoB: His parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius echoes Donny's every word when Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court. When Donny's act lets demons loose, Donny apologizes to him, and Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: The magician he hype-mans
stages.whoB: His hype man at the Mystic Castle

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius sides with Donny against Wong's cease and desist and in court. When demons overrun the magic show, Wong and Jen fight them off and Cornelius gives in.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer suing Donny
stages.whoB: Donny's hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen asks Cornelius if he is just hype-manning Donny when he echoes him. During the demon attack she holds a demon over the pair until Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer, who serves the cease and desist
stages.whoB: Donny's echoing hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing at the DA's office and needles She-Hulk at the bar. When he sues the woman who posed as Megan Thee Stallion, Jen testifies he is deluded enough to believe it, and he wins. Later he tells television that he dated her and she was psycho.
stages.whoA: A former coworker who testifies he is deluded
stages.whoB: A smug former coworker at the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Bukowski brings his suit against the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion to GLK&H and picks Pug as his lawyer. Pug calls Jen as a witness and wins him $175,000.
stages.whoA: His lawyer at GLK&H
stages.whoB: A client from the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Runa posed as Megan Thee Stallion and took Bukowski for $175,000 before revealing herself. He sues her, and she loses and is jailed for impersonating a judge.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who scammed him
stages.whoB: The mark she scammed as Megan Thee Stallion

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki jokes that she will kill Dennis when he tries to take Jen's closing, and later tells him to take a lap at the bar. She calls him gross before Jen testifies in his case.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who cannot stand him
stages.whoB: A coworker she cannot stand

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong sues Donny for using the Mystic Arts in his shows after he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj. Donny mocks him and wins a ruling to keep performing. When demons pour through, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to stop.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who sues him
stages.whoB: A Kamar-Taj dropout misusing magic

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen serves Donny with Wong's cease and desist, and he mocks her dating app. During the demon attack she holds a demon over him until he agrees to sign.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer
stages.whoB: The magician she serves with papers

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Donny sends Madisynn through a portal during his show into a realm full of demons. She later testifies about it in Wong's case against him.
stages.whoA: A volunteer he sent through a portal
stages.whoB: The magician who sent her through a portal

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding and they share fries after her fight with Titania. After a few dates he draws her blood as she sleeps, copies her phone and ghosts her. A recording of their night is later shown at her awards gala.
stages.whoA: The woman he seduced to steal her blood
stages.whoB: A charming date who ghosts her

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: After taking Jen's blood, Josh texts HulkKing that the job is done. Todd later admits he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, who hired him
stages.whoB: The man he hired to seduce Jen

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh is a guest of the groom at Lulu's wedding. Lulu pulls Jen away from him to help her clean up inside.
stages.whoA: The bride at the wedding he attends
stages.whoB: A guest of the groom

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen breaks out of her show and confronts K.E.V.I.N., who says he makes every decision. She argues her ending is a mess, and he agrees to her changes. He then locks her out and jokes about seeing her on the big screen.
stages.whoA: The hero who rewrites his ending
stages.whoB: The AI who makes the decisions

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Lulu, Jen's old high school friend, makes her a bridesmaid and makes her promise not to be She-Hulk at the wedding. She dismisses Jen's fears about Titania and puts her to work. After the fight, a tipsy Lulu hugs She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Her high school friend and bridesmaid
stages.whoB: Her high school friend, the bride

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania turns up at Lulu's wedding as a guest. Lulu welcomes her and tells Jen she sounds insane for thinking Titania came to cause trouble.
stages.whoA: A celebrity guest at her wedding
stages.whoB: The bride at the wedding she crashes

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At a family dinner, Melanie offers to give Jen chunky highlights like She-Hulk's hair. At the barbecue she sits by Jen and Matt.
stages.whoA: Jen, whose hair she offers to restyle
stages.whoB: A stylist at the family dinners

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the Walters family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt and asks why he does not stay longer. She is pulled away to help with the hamburgers.
stages.whoA: Jen's date at the barbecue
stages.whoB: A guest who flirts with him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price rejects Runa's claim of diplomatic immunity, saying Thor's speeches are not admissible. After Runa poses as him to drop the case, he jails her for 60 days.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who impersonates him
stages.whoB: The judge she impersonates

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price presides as Jen gives her closing when Titania crashes in. He rules on Bukowski's case after her testimony, and later sides with Matt against her in the Patilio suit.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who appears in his court
stages.whoB: A judge who hears her cases

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt arrives late to Price's court to defend Luke Jacobson. Price agrees the client list stays private, and dismisses the case once Matt shows the plaintiff used jet fuel.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who wins in his court
stages.whoB: The judge who rules his way

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca is at the family dinner after Jen is fired and scolds Ched for bringing it up. At the barbecue Jen tells her not to ask Matt how much money he makes.
stages.whoA: Her niece Jen
stages.whoB: Her Aunt Rebecca

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the barbecue, Rebecca quizzes Matt about his Hell's Kitchen practice. When he says he takes cases that do not pay, she concludes he does not make much money.
stages.whoA: Jen's date, a Hell's Kitchen lawyer
stages.whoB: Jen's aunt, who grills him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to mention Jen's firing before Ched blurts it out. At the barbecue he points out to Rebecca that Matt has his own practice.
stages.whoA: A relative who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative at the family meals

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen testifies in Bukowski's suit that he is deluded enough to have believed Runa was Megan Thee Stallion. Her testimony wins the case, and Runa is jailed.
stages.whoA: The witness who sinks her case
stages.whoB: The scammer in Bukowski's case

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Pug represents Bukowski in his suit against Runa and sees through her when she poses as the judge. He wins full damages for his client.
stages.whoA: The lawyer suing her
stages.whoB: The defendant he beats in court

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball and his crew jump Jen with stolen Asgardian tools, and he tries to take her blood with a needle. It bends on her skin, and the crew flees.
stages.whoA: The Hulk whose blood he fails to take
stages.whoB: A thug who tries to take her blood

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball fails to get She-Hulk's blood, and his crew leader says their boss is going to be mad. He later sits at the Intelligencia gathering where Todd turns out to be its founder, HulkKing.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, the head of Intelligencia
stages.whoB: A member at his Intelligencia gathering
